name: code-janitor
description: Professional code formatter and AI-powered syntax fixer for C, C++, Arduino, Java, JavaScript, Python, and HTML. Features Alt+D instant syntax fix with NVIDIA/Ollama/Groq AI, live preview, intelligent code analysis, and Graphify project visualization.

codeJanitor.autoCorrection.enabled.description: Enable real-time auto-correction as you type (DISABLED by default to prevent code corruption)

codeJanitor.autoCorrection.delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before auto-correction triggers (default: 500ms)

codeJanitor.autoFixOnSave.enabled.description: Enable auto-fix when saving files (DISABLED by default to prevent code corruption)

codeJanitor.ai.enabled.description: Enable AI-powered syntax fixing and chat features

codeJanitor.ai.provider.description: AI provider: ollama (local, default), groq (cloud, FASTEST, free), openrouter (cloud, 100+ models), anthropic (Claude), nvidia (NVIDIA NIM)

codeJanitor.ai.anthropicApiKey.description: Legacy migration-only field. Use the Code Janitor chat provider key prompt so the key is stored in VS Code SecretStorage.

codeJanitor.ai.nvidiaApiKey.description: Legacy migration-only field. Use the Code Janitor chat provider key prompt so the key is stored in VS Code SecretStorage.

codeJanitor.ai.nvidiaModel.description: NVIDIA NIM model id. When an NVIDIA API key is available, Code Janitor fetches the current supported NVIDIA model list at runtime.

codeJanitor.ai.groqApiKey.description: Legacy migration-only field. Use the Code Janitor chat provider key prompt so the key is stored in VS Code SecretStorage.

codeJanitor.ai.openrouterApiKey.description: Legacy migration-only field. Use the Code Janitor chat provider key prompt so the key is stored in VS Code SecretStorage.

codeJanitor.ai.model.description: AI model to use. Leave empty to use the provider default. For OpenRouter use slugs like qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct. For Ollama use qwen2.5-coder:1.5b. For NVIDIA NIM use a current model id such as meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct.

codeJanitor.ai.timeout.description: AI request timeout in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable the timeout (default), or increase it if using slow models like MiniMax M2.7.

codeJanitor.ai.rateLimit.enabled.description: Throttle cloud AI provider requests to avoid provider rate-limit errors. Local Ollama requests are not throttled.

codeJanitor.ai.rateLimit.requestsPerMinu.description: Maximum cloud AI requests per minute before Code Janitor queues requests.

codeJanitor.ai.rateLimit.burst.description: Number of cloud AI requests Code Janitor can send immediately before spacing requests out.

codeJanitor.ai.rateLimit.maxWaitMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds Code Janitor will wait for a cloud AI rate-limit slot. Set to 0 to wait without a cap.

codeJanitor.ai.showParsedActionsDebug.description: Show parsed AI actions in chat status messages for debugging

codeJanitor.ai.gstackGateMode.description: Run a GStack-inspired pre-execution review gate for AI-generated edits. smart reviews only riskier edits, always reviews every AI-generated edit, off disables it.

codeJanitor.ai.selfHealing.enabled.description: Enable automatic performance monitoring and optimization (self-healing)

codeJanitor.ai.selfHealing.slowThreshold.description: Response time threshold in milliseconds to trigger self-healing (default: 30 seconds)

codeJanitor.ai.maxTokens.fast.description: Maximum tokens for fast mode responses (default: 4096, range: 512-8192)

codeJanitor.ai.maxTokens.heavy.description: Maximum tokens for heavy mode responses (default: 8192, range: 1024-16384)

codeJanitor.ai.maxTokens.deep.description: Maximum tokens for deep mode responses (default: 12288, range: 2048-16384)

codeJanitor.ai.maxTokens.create.description: Maximum tokens for create mode (file generation) responses (default: 16384, range: 2048-32768)

codeJanitor.github.apiToken.description: Legacy migration-only field. Use Code Janitor settings UI to store the token in VS Code SecretStorage, or set GITHUB_TOKEN.

codeJanitor.github.apiBaseUrl.description: GitHub API base URL. Change this for GitHub Enterprise Server instances.

codeJanitor.assistant.workspaceMemory.en.description: Continuously track workspace file activity and maintain a reusable Markdown repo ledger plus a structured workspace.json manifest with Graphify, Git, and GitHub context for AI handoff.

codeJanitor.assistant.workspaceMemory.au.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before Code Janitor refreshes workspace memory after tracked file changes.

codeJanitor.assistant.workspaceMemory.ma.description: Maximum number of recent tracked workspace changes, including before/after snapshots, kept in the assistant memory log.

codeJanitor.assistant.workspaceMemory.in.description: Include GitHub repository context in the generated workspace memory file when available.

codeJanitor.assistant.workspaceMemory.ge.description: Choose whether workspace memory is rendered from the built-in template or rewritten by a preferred AI provider such as IBM BOB.

codeJanitor.assistant.workspaceMemory.ai.description: Preferred provider id for AI-generated workspace memory. Leave empty to use the current chat provider.

codeJanitor.assistant.workspaceMemory.mi.description: Mirror the generated workspace memory to a shared lowercase workspacememory.md file at the workspace root.

codeJanitor.assistant.workspaceMemory.ou.description: Workspace-relative path for the generated assistant memory Markdown repo ledger. Code Janitor also writes a structured workspace.json manifest at the workspace root.

codeJanitor.assistant.projectPlanner.ena.description: Enable the outcome-based project planner, pinned progress bar, and stale-progress rescue briefs.

codeJanitor.assistant.projectPlanner.pre.description: Preferred provider id for project planner generation and rescue briefs. Leave empty to use the current chat provider.

codeJanitor.assistant.projectPlanner.sta.description: Minutes of low or no progress before Code Janitor asks the preferred provider to generate a rescue brief.

codeJanitor.testing.aiAssist.enabled.description: Allow a preferred AI provider such as IBM BOB to augment edge-case generation and test-report review.

codeJanitor.testing.aiAssist.provider.description: Preferred provider id for AI-assisted edge-case generation and test review. Leave empty to use the current chat provider.

commands.title: Generate Edge Cases for Active File

keybindings.when: editorTextFocus && (resourceExtname == '.html' || resourceExtname == '.htm' || resourceExtname == '.css' || resourceExtname == '.scss' || resourceExtname == '.sass' || resourceExtname == '.less' || resourceExtname == '.js' || resourceExtname == '.jsx' || resourceExtname == '.mjs' || resourceExtname == '.cjs' || resourceExtname == '.ts' || resourceExtname == '.tsx')

scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:java && npm run format:py && npm run format:c && npm run format:html
